templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard mutual NDA created by a committee of 40+ attorneys. Covers confidentiality obligations, exclusions, term, and remedies for both parties sharing confidential information.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA containing deal-specific terms (party names, governing law, term, etc.) that incorporates the standard Mutual NDA terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard B2B SaaS subscription contract covering access rights, fees, data handling, warranties, liability limits, and termination for cloud-hosted software services.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard SLA addendum defining uptime commitments, measurement methodology, service credits for downtime, and exclusions for cloud services.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR and CCPA-compliant DPA covering processor/controller obligations, permitted purposes, subprocessor management, data subject rights, security measures, and breach notification.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant BAA for covered entities and business associates handling protected health information (PHI), covering permitted uses, safeguards, and breach reporting.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard perpetual or term license agreement for on-premise or downloadable software, covering license scope, restrictions, support obligations, and IP ownership.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard consulting and professional services contract covering SOW incorporation, deliverables, IP ownership, payment terms, confidentiality, and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for technology channel partnerships, reseller arrangements, or referral programs covering appointment, obligations, fees, and term.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for early-access design partner programs where customers receive pre-release product access in exchange for structured feedback.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Standard addendum for AI/ML product use cases addressing training data restrictions, model output disclaimers, acceptable use policies, and AI-specific liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard time-limited pilot or proof-of-concept agreement covering scope, duration, fees (if any), evaluation criteria, and conversion terms to a full agreement.
